逐句核对 NL（3 句）：
NL1「This state machine model represents the train's basic braking device, which serves as the final execution unit for train braking operations」——满足：模型确实以基础制动装置为对象，四个状态（初始 / 制动 / 运行 / 夹紧）覆盖 NL 描述的执行环节。此句为背景性陈述，无具体元素义务。
NL2「When the basic braking device receives a brake signal, it transitions from the initial state to the braking state. If the signal transmission fails, it proceeds to the operational state. Once the signal feedback is sent, it returns to the initial state」——三个分句全部满足：InitialState --> BrakingState : Brake Signal Received；InitialState --> OperationalState : Signal Transmission Fails；OperationalState --> InitialState 与 BrakingState --> InitialState 均带 Signal Feedback Sent。
NL3「After entering the braking state, the system transitions to the brake caliper clamping state」——满足：BrakingState --> ClampingState，且 ClampingState 标注为「Brake Caliper Clamping State」。

良构性检查（gen）：根初始边 [*] --> InitialState 无触发，合规；四个状态全部有出边，无死端、无吸收态、无不可达状态（FCSTM 投影确认为扁平的四状态六迁移模型）；非初始边全部带触发，无即发 completion 边。因此本 case 判 0 个 problem。

参考模型自身问题：
(1) `Braking_State --> Brake_Caliper_Closed_State` 无标签，是即发 completion 边，与参考自己的 `Braking_State --> Initial_State : Send_signal_feedback` 竞争，后者能否被取到存疑。
(2) `Running_State --> Brake_Caliper_Relaxed_State` 同样是无标签即发边，同样会挤压参考自己的 `Running_State --> Initial_State : Send_signal_feedback` 分支。
(3) Brake_Caliper_Closed_State 与 Brake_Caliper_Relaxed_State 在参考中都是死端。
(4) Brake_Caliper_Relaxed_State（夹钳松开）在 NL 中完全没有依据。
以上四点合并体现在 uncertain 与 similar 两条 diff 的理由中。
